column3: E-Even if you say that... I-I'm not sure either...!
Oh no!  Manami got so nervous, she started calling for help!
Bewildered and not knowing what to do, she takes a doll out of her bag and puts it in front of her face.
Fight! It's alright～ Just be yourself～
She started talking to the doll...
Yes, I'm okay now. Sorry about that, Kyou-chan～
Ah, it's a good luck charm that's popular in the model world right now. Ayase told me that she does this when she is nervous.
Aaah... Yeah... It's good that it wasn't something more serious...
That's probably what Ayase does to relax before photoshoots... after confirming no one's around, that is...
No, you seemed like you were about to faint so... I was thinking that I had to catch you.
Eh! T-T-That means, um, that is...
You don't have to say any more.
